newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: AT&T, ABACUS upgrade travel service network.
newsitem.headline: AT&T, ABACUS upgrade travel service network.

text.p: AT&T said on Monday it had signed a contract with ABACUS Distribution Systems Pte Ltd to develop a strategic multimedia-based network plan.
The company said in a statement the plan will eventually allow travel agents and airlines to use a variety of multimedia applications.
ABACUS provides comprehensive travel information and mega-Computerised Reservation System (CRS) services specially tailored for the Asia Pacific market.
The mega-CRS gives over 6,600 travel agencies in 14 countries access to information about airlines, car rentals, cruises and access to over 160 hotel chains.

The system is jointly owned by All Nippon Airways, Cathay Pacific Airways, China Airlines, EVA Airways, Garuda Indonesia, Hong Kong Dragon Airlines, Malaysian Airlines, Philippine Airlines, Royal Brunei Airlines, SilkAir, Singapore Airlines and a US-based mega-CRS, WORLDSPAN Travel Information Services.
